# David Packer Recommends Ring Strength Skills Twice A Week And Front Lever Three To Four Times A Week From His Own Experience

In the interview on SasaVenos's channel, David Packer recommends ring strength skills twice a week and front lever three to four times a week, from his own experience. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Details

- He recommends iron cross, maltese, victorian and "anything that puts a lot of stress on your tendons" twice a week. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- He says front lever responds very well to higher frequency, and calls this "my experience". [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- For front lever he says "I think" a minimum of three to four times a week. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Evidence

- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "i would recommend training iron cross maltese victorian anything that puts a lot of stress on your tendons um twice a week front lever for example i think responds when pull-ups respond very well to higher frequency um yeah that's that's my experience"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "well i'll say front lever i think front leave a minimum of like three three to four times a week it really res well i responded extremely well to doing it like very often"
